initiatives.title: Circulation: Cupping, Colour, and Collective Sensing
initiatives.description: SCD School Research Seed Funding (VND 90,000,000), accepted and ongoing. Project lead. Three handheld cupping-form devices with pressure and pulse (PPG) sensors, mapping bodily state to the Five Elements (오행) colour framework, with Patrick Hartono and Renusha Athugala, mentored by Dr. Hellmut Monz.
initiatives.location: RMIT University Vietnam · SCD School Research Seed Funding, internal

initiatives.title: Touch of Water: Memory-Mapping with AR and Sound Journal
initiatives.description: Half-day research workshop at the 5th FCM 2026 Postgraduate Students Re-Ignite conference, with Sigisora (Van Luber Parensen and Dyah Nindyasari, sound journal) and Prof. Suk-Jun Kim (University of Aberdeen, workshop coordinator). Extends the British Academy-funded project "Futures of Listening: Water Knowledge from Two Cities" (PI Prof. Suk-Jun Kim) into Southeast Asia, with RMIT Vietnam, Multimedia University, and Forum Lenteng Jakarta. Draws on the Lọc WebAR installation as its AR component.
initiatives.location: Faculty of Creative Multimedia, Multimedia University, Cyberjaya, Malaysia · June 24, 2026

initiatives.description: Five-day intensive cross-cultural hackathon between Dong-Ah Institute of Media and Arts (New Media Contents) and RMIT University Vietnam (Digital Media). 6 mixed teams. Organizer & Moderator.

initiatives.title: ISEA 2026 Workshop
initiatives.description: Counting Cultural Stars: Transforming Cultural Texts into Volumetric Constellations. Accepted workshop at the International Symposium on Electronic Art, co-organized with Patrick Hartono.

initiatives.title: AI-Assisted Photographic Assessment: A Discipline-Informed Feedback Tool
initiatives.description: GAILE-Sponsored Seed Grant collaboration developing a rubric-encoded AI feedback tool, trialled across Art & Photography (RMIT Melbourne) and Photography 101 (RMIT Vietnam). Applicant: Assoc. Prof. Shane Hulbert, with Dr Rebecca Najdowski and Dr Arlo Mountford, RMIT Melbourne School of Art. RMIT Vietnam design and development partnership.

initiatives.title: Maek (맥): Acupoint and Meridian Mapping as Somatic Interface
initiatives.description: Hand-tracking prototype overlaying acupuncture points and meridian channels live, solved per-person from cun-proportional (골도분촌) rules against MediaPipe hand landmarks. Phase 1 built.

initiatives.title: Bagua Theremin
initiatives.description: Browser theremin split across the eight I-Ching trigrams: hand position sets pitch and colour, height sets volume. Built as a WebAR 3D bagua mirror scene.

initiatives.title: Perforated Atlas
initiatives.description: Museum browser artwork translating a typed memory of Ho Chi Minh City's vanishing water into a perforated music-box strip; the words are destroyed, only the pattern survives. A physical ESP32 machine apparatus is in development alongside the web version.

initiatives.title: vanitas (gelora-soil)
initiatives.description: Front-camera WebAR piece in the Gelora lineage: a photographed flower and an offered palm grow a mutating 3D bloom seeded from the flower's own colour, which wilts and pours away.

initiatives.title: Tứ Bình
initiatives.description: Catch-and-harmonize colour piece: closing a hand catches a colour, which follows the hand and harmonizes with a second catch.
